title: Add Storybook 10 with nextjs-vite framework
body:
## Summary
- Initialize Storybook 10 with `@storybook/nextjs-vite` framework
- Lean addon set: `addon-a11y` and `addon-docs` only
- Import `globals.css` in preview for Tailwind support
- Remove scaffold extras (chromatic, addon-vitest/playwright, addon-onboarding, sample stories)

## Test plan
- [x] CI passes (test, lint, format, build)
- [x] `pnpm build-storybook` completes successfully (verified locally)

Closes #6
